acip: DE'I PHYIR TSOGS KYI ZHING 'GRAN ZLA MED PA BLA MA YIN PAS TSOGS GSOG PA BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYI SGO NAS BYED CING, SGRIB PA SBYANG BA RDOR SEMS BSGOM BZLAS KYI KHONGS SU 'DU GSUNGS,
wylie: de'i phyir tshogs kyi zhing 'gran zla med pa bla ma yin pas tshogs gsog pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas byed cing, sgrib pa sbyang ba rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi khongs su 'du gsungs
english: Therefore the one object that is unsurpassed for amassing virtue is your Lama; and this, said our Lama, is why we gather the collections of virtue through this practice of the Lama.  The sister practice of purifying ourselves of our obstacles then is incorporated into the meditation and recitation of the Warrior of Diamond.
